ownership_summary: Owned since 7 October 2021 by an investment group led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), which bought 100% of Newcastle United Limited and the football club from Mike Ashley's St. James Holdings. After PIF and RB Sports & Media (the Reuben family) bought out PCP Capital Partners in July 2024, PIF controls around 85% and RB Sports & Media the remaining 15%. The registered parent chain is Newcastle United Limited, owned by PZ Newco Limited, owned by NCUK Investment Limited.
